description: THIS TEAM IS FROM CHRIST KING ENGLISH MEDIUM SCHOOL KARKALA
summary: Grox-Nauts is a Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer for ages 9-14, built for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. Instead of a game, it is a training app: students work through "Flight Cases" retold from real astronaut stories (Chris Hadfield, Harrison Schmitt, Scott Kelly, Samantha Cristoforetti, Suni Williams and Butch Wilmore, and ISS emergency crews). Each case has decision steps with kind explanations, and finishing one earns a badge that says "You solved the problem faced by [astronaut]". An Astronaut Academy and six extras help kids learn what astronauts really face, in 6 languages, on phone, tablet or laptop.
details: AI TOOLS USED AND WHAT THEY PROVIDED Our team made the ideas, topic choice, design decisions and final selections. AI helped us research, draft and build faster. - Claude (Anthropic): summarised the NASA and Canadian Space Agency (CSA) resources for our challenge (NASA Open APIs, DONKI, OSDR, RadLab, Mars Trek, and the CSA food and STEM resources); collected and paraphrased facts from public astronaut interviews (Chris Hadfield, Scott Kelly, Samantha Cristoforetti, Harrison Schmitt, Suni Williams and Butch Wilmore); and wrote the app's code, the six Flight Cases, the 46-topic Ask an Astronaut answers, bug fixes, the installable web-app files and this write-up. - ChatGPT (OpenAI): helped create our Grox logo and the home page artwork. - Gemini (Google): helped create our demo video. Our team reviewed the content, chose the cases, tested the app and is responsible for the final project.
